title: Expose the protected Lesson Context payment adapter
verify: The Lesson Context form/action is a thin server adapter that resolves the current lesson/student scope and delegates payment creation to FinancialLedgerBoundary.
Student, unassigned Teacher, cross-center, forged-scope, and direct-SQL paths fail before mutation; this task does not prove the personal calendar projection or inherit TASK-050 E2E evidence.
evidence_required: Financial Ledger public-boundary adapter / REQ-013 RED: Lesson Context writes SQLite directly, trusts client scope, or cannot delegate to the named createPayment command; GREEN: the protected adapter rechecks server scope and delegates without owning financial persistence; artifact: .tasks/TASK-049-T3-FT-006-W25/ and .protocols/TASK-049-T3-FT-006-W25/.
purpose: Own the Lesson Context transport boundary that invokes the accepted payment command.
success_outcome: An authorized Admin or assigned Teacher can submit the existing Lesson Context payment form through a thin adapter, while unauthorized actors are rejected before financial mutation.
anti_goals: Do not write financial tables from the route or lesson-context module.
Do not implement the student paid/unpaid calendar projection or a real-DB E2E gate.
constraints: Lesson Context is an adapter only; Financial Ledger owns payment writes.
Server resolves actor, center, class, lesson, and student scope; client values cannot widen it.
invariants: No route-owned SQL or second financial store exists.
Unauthorized submission leaves financial state unchanged.
verification_targets: Boundary probe: assigned Teacher/Admin delegation, Student/unassigned/cross-center denial, forged fields, state-before/state-after, and source proof of no direct SQLite access.
Run project check/build/test; do not run or require the real-DB payment E2E here.

stop_conditions: Stop if the adapter requires direct financial persistence, a new API boundary, or client-owned authorization.
